title: Framer button
description: Small, square-cornered app buttons: a solid white button with black text and a quiet dark-grey one, 28px on phones and 34px on desktop, with an optional icon after the label. Hover lightens the fill.
notes: primary is the theme's primary colour (white on the dark faithful theme); secondary is the secondary surface
name: framer-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: solid white (theme primary) · secondary: quiet dark-grey surface

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 30px header button · md: 28px on phones, 34px on desktop

props.name: icon
props.description: small icon after the label (e.g. a download arrow)
